{
  "signals_observed": [
    "date: 2024-03-16; merchant_id: 62",
    "trigger_codes: [\"B\"]",
    "Trigger: AUP-06.1 breach: 30d chargeback rate 3.4% (3 disputes / 87 orders)",
    "cb_rate_30d: 0.034482758620689655; disputes_30d: 3; orders_30d: 87",
    "gmv_30d: 1038451 cents; base_gmv: 1695470 cents; base_orders: 141; base_days: 46",
    "volume_z: -0.43946926917969337; ticket_drift: 0.9926491138760628",
    "new_gmv_30d: 411349 cents; new_gmv_share: 0.39611787171469814",
    "refunds_30d: 0; refund_rate_30d: 0.0; base_refunds: 0; base_refund_rate: 0.0",
    "merchant_age_days: 794; days_since_first_order: 75; cum_orders: 228",
    "n_disputes: 1; n_orders: 2"
  ],
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "kind": "bustout",
      "likelihood": "low",
      "reasoning": "The chargeback breach warrants investigation, but volume_z is negative and ticket_drift is near 1, providing no observed sales-ramp signal. New-GMV share alone does not establish thin buyer accounts, and fulfillment failures are unconfirmed."
    },
    {
      "kind": "category_norm",
      "likelihood": "med",
      "reasoning": "Three disputes could represent ordinary complaint clustering in a modest order sample. Category benchmarks, historical dispute rates and dispute reasons are missing, so this explanation remains provisional."
    },
    {
      "kind": "marketing_push",
      "likelihood": "low",
      "reasoning": "A campaign could explain new-buyer sales, but no campaign evidence or elevated volume is supplied. It would not by itself explain the disputes."
    },
    {
      "kind": "data_issue",
      "likelihood": "low",
      "reasoning": "The reported chargeback rate agrees with 3 divided by 87, with no obvious arithmetic inconsistency. Duplicate disputes, missing orders or incorrect window attribution still require record-level checks."
    }
  ],
  "recommended_action": "reserve",
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "Inspect the three dispute records for unique transaction IDs, reasons, dates, status and links to the 87 orders; reconcile against source records to confirm or invalidate the breach.",
    "Check fulfillment evidence for disputed orders first, then a small sample of recent orders: shipment tracking, delivery confirmation or service completion. Repeated verified non-delivery would strengthen bust-out concern.",
    "Reconcile refund requests, cancellations and pending refunds with the zero recorded refunds; distinguish absent requests from unprocessed or missing refunds.",
    "Obtain dated campaign records and compare promoted orders with fulfillment and disputes; fulfilled campaign sales would support a benign explanation.",
    "Compare historical and category dispute rates, and inspect buyer-account age and repeated buyer/payment links; establish whether complaint levels and buyer concentration are unusual."
  ],
  "memo_markdown": "Merchant 62 breached the chargeback trigger: 3 disputes across 87 trailing-30-day orders (3.45%). GMV was 1,038,451 cents. Volume_z was -0.439 and ticket_drift was 0.993, so the supplied comparisons do not show a sales ramp or larger tickets. New-GMV share was 39.61%; this does not establish thin buyer accounts. No refunds were recorded. Comparison history covers 46 baseline days.\n\nRecommend a temporary payout reserve while the human reviewer verifies the breach and fulfillment. The dispute count warrants review, but bust-out is uncorroborated; these metrics do not justify offboarding.\n\nStart with the three dispute records and their delivery evidence. Repeated verified non-delivery, linked thin buyer accounts and unresolved refund requests would strengthen bust-out concern. Valid delivery evidence and ordinary complaint reasons would weaken it. Duplicate disputes or missing denominator orders could invalidate the alert. Reconcile refund requests against recorded refunds, and check dated campaign records and category dispute benchmarks. A campaign explanation requires evidence of fulfilled sales; it does not erase a valid chargeback breach. Reassess the reserve after these checks and watch the next window."
}
